module Test.GEN.04

import Test.Generics.Pos exposing make_palette
type SC is record
    red: Integer
    green: Integer
    blue: Integer
end record
function oob() returns Integer
is
    let pal: Array<SC, 3> = make_palette()
    return pal[3]
end oob

end Test.GEN.04
